subject.title: fix: preserve OpenAI Responses message boundaries

question: Does the affected rotating-ID cumulative provider stream actually reuse one `output_index`, or must the compatibility rule also support changing or missing indices?
rationale: The answer determines whether the new discriminator preserves shipped behavior; synthetic events and SDK types cannot establish the provider's real wire shape.

options.title: Require captured-stream proof
options.body: Replay redacted captured events through a real agent turn and adjust the lineage rule until both the original cumulative stream and the separate-message regression pass.

options.title: Accept the same-index assumption
options.body: Merge using `output_index` as the rotating-ID lineage signal despite the unresolved risk that the original provider stream uses changing or absent indices.

recommendation.title: Require captured-stream proof
recommendation.body: Replay redacted captured events through a real agent turn and adjust the lineage rule until both the original cumulative stream and the separate-message regression pass.
